newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Peters says no secret parts of coalition deal.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Peters says no secret parts of coalition deal.

text.p: New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters on Friday said there were no other coalition agreements than those made public on December 11.
"There are no other agreements. Statements to the contrary are based on misunderstandings, misinformation or mischievousness," Peters said in a written statement.

He was responding to newspaper reports that in a previously undisclosed addendum to the coalition deal the conservative National Party and Peters' nationalist New Zealand First Party had agreed to consider selling some parts of the national grid operator Trans Power.
